data_exposure: All180 room images and numerical reference source were previously evaluated. This is not an unseen generalization test.

reference: Last accepted measured grayscale/depth/root; fresh FAST features are reseeded on accepted frames. Pairwise identities only; no persistent landmarks.
correspondence_selection: First maximum256 valid measured depth pairs in original previous feature order; preserve all other endpoint/depth witnesses.
preregistration: Freeze executable and22sources, verify source-bound timestamp qualification and independent synthetic controls before first candidate fit.
tuning: Helper defaults fixed using synthetic translation/negative fixtures; no recorded camera fit used to select them.
limitations: No calibrated covariance, automotive sensor calibration or driving fusion.
Additive exposure offset only; gain, projective rotation/scale, repeated-texture uniqueness and recovery remain unsupported.
All179 attempted updates and physical/accuracy failures remain in the denominator.
